inputs.userGoal: preciso criar um poc para simular se posso aumentar o size the uma subnet para o azure apim
subGoals: Reproduce Premium classic External networking with an isolated Developer instance, not Premium availability.
Only attempt occupied-subnet expansion from /27 to /26 and record the Azure response; no APIM migration.
User authorized deployment in the subscription recorded in local .env, eastus2, and one occupied-subnet resize attempt; no migration or automatic deletion.

reasoning.tradeoffs: Operator must delete the lab after collecting results.

properties.outbound: Default outbound rules retained for APIM dependencies; no forced tunneling.

reasoning.tradeoffs: Lab outbound access is not a hardened production baseline.

reasoning.whyChosen: Contain a single subnet and its expanded range inside /16.
reasoning.tradeoffs: No enterprise routing or backend connectivity reproduction.

reasoning.whyChosen: Test 32 to 64 total addresses, 27 to 59 Azure-usable addresses.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Documentation requires an empty subnet for prefix changes.
No SLA; downtime is expected during changes; does not validate Premium capacity or availability.

reasoning.whyChosen: Observe gateway HTTP status, exact payload and latency without backend dependencies.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Public non-sensitive mock only; no private backend, throughput or end-to-end business validation.

overallReasoning.summary: Isolated single-region lab with one occupied subnet. Only mutation is /27 to /26; explicit confirmation, recorded Azure response and before/after state. HTTP monitoring is optional.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: No DDoS paid plan, firewall, Log Analytics, private endpoints or multi-region infrastructure for this short-lived low-cost lab. These omissions and default egress are not production guidance.

plan.validation: All dependencies resolve. One subnet starts at 10.90.0.0/27 and expands to 10.90.0.0/26 inside 10.90.0.0/16. No subnet delegation or temporary subnet. APIM Developer External, NSG, subnet and VNet share subscription and region. No APIM update or automatic fallback. Direct resize is an experiment, not a supported-operation claim. Local compile/tests required; runtime outcome remains unverified until cloud execution.
